seen_before_writing: All ws_cas Part 1-4 diagnosis outputs, on odd and even genomes: per-locus classes (post and r2sel), oracle landscapes O1g/O1c/O2g/O2c/O3c/O4c and A1/A2/A5/A6 (token-significant instances added or dropped; diagnostic, use MMseqs2 significance), and the UNGATED union counterfactuals U3/U4/U6 (post reading, added instances unlabelled: W >= 1 or P <= 1e-3 / 1e-4 / 1e-6 at depth 1,000, L >= 2): even CCT F1 +0.049 / +0.045 / +0.035 over post, summed excess -0.164 / -0.141 / -0.113, DefenseFinder F1 -0.055 / -0.042 / -0.033, resolved 1,274 / 1,308 / 1,376, rule FDR .0042 / .0022 / .0022. No number of any kind exists for the gated second tier below; no job computing it has been submitted.
mechanism: The CRISPR-Cas deficit is in the landscape (Part 1: net -0.054 even from loci whose token best locus has a boundary without embedding support; reading net +0.017), and 87% of that landscape loss (-0.058 of -0.067 even) is the rank-weight floor: few-lineage pairs (token L 2-7 for 65% of lost instances) whose family homologs ARE in the depth-1,000 lists (58% of the token's supporting genera recovered; Cas genes at or above matched non-Cas genes) but at deep ranks (median best family-consistent rank 107), so W_e50 < 1 (median .04). The loss concentrates in loci with no embedding support at all ('missed': 209 even loci, -0.053). The Poisson tail of G given E at depth 1,000 recognises a large part of these instances at low null FDR (AUC vs null .935-1.00 at L >= 5; P <= 1e-4 marks 49% of the lost Cas boundaries at FDR .0002), but admitting it everywhere extends loci that tier 1 already supports and destroys summed excess (ungated U3/U4/U6 above). Homolog exclusion (embedding L = -1) is a second, Cas-enriched mechanism (7.0% of token-significant Cas instances vs 1.8% non-Cas; adjacent RAMP / effector genes) worth at most +0.008 CCT F1 (oracle A5); it is not addressed by this fix.
change: Gated second tier. Tier 1 = the base landscape (rw1000_e50: W_e50 >= 1 and L >= 2 at depth 1,000), unchanged. Tier 2 = instances with L >= 2 and Poisson P(X >= G | E) <= 10^-e at depth 1,000 (the stored round-2 statistic: G, E over genomes from the same zca10 lists, own-genome term included) that are not tier 1 AND whose whole gene interval [left, left + d] contains no gene touched by any tier-1 instance interval (gene g touched if some tier-1 instance has left <= g <= left + d). Tier-2 instances therefore never share a boundary with a tier-1 run: tier-1 R1 runs, H cores, labels and loci are identical to the base, and tier 2 only adds island loci where tier 1 is silent. Boundary support of tier-2 instances = their L (as tier 1); tier-2 instances carry no module label (-1; rule C fills, so islands are not cut); H trims islands with the same f. No step reads taxonomy beyond the single pluggable lineage array (L counts lineages; default GTDB genus, as the base); no step reads MMseqs2 families or caller labels.
base: round-4 post hoc configuration (post hoc in round 4, not predeclared there): landscape rw1000_e50, instance-graph labels ic:k5o0.3_g1 (k 5 support edges, overlap edges w_o 0.3, Leiden gamma 1, communities of >= 2 instances labelled), DH with trimming f 0.8. Reproduced here exactly before any comparison (even CCT F1 .442717; per-instance F1 max diff 0).
grid: e in {3, 4, 6, 8}; plus e = none (tier 2 empty) as the reproduction check of the base.
fdr: Genome-wide instance FDR of the combined rule (tier 1 or gated tier 2) = mean over the three stored gene-order nulls (seeds 1000-1002) of null instances passing / observed instances passing, with tier 1, touched genes and the gate recomputed in each null's own order (slots). A configuration whose combined FDR exceeds 0.01 is dropped before selection. Tier-2-alone FDR (null gated tier 2 / observed gated tier 2) is reported.
odd_selection: Round 4's odd score on odd genomes (odd shadow gold package, 848 odd ribosomal runs): total shortfall to the odd-scaled 'matches' bars (each quantity in units of its tolerance: summed excess, F1 of the three callers, ribosomal recovered, Parvarchaeaceae recovered, resolved), then odd summed excess. The best e by (minus shortfall, summed) is THE configuration; ties go to the larger e (fewer added instances). The selection is written in NOTEBOOK_cas.txt before any even-genome score of a gated configuration is computed.
even_criterion: Selected configuration's DH against token DH (rescue3) on even genomes, paired genome bootstrap (2,000 draws, seed 17), ribosomal on all 1,686 runs. MATCHES: summed DF+TXSS excess >= token - 0.01 (point estimate); F1 of each of DefenseFinder, TXSScan, CRISPRCasTyper >= token - 0.02 (point estimate); ribosomal recovered >= 1,650, Parvarchaeaceae recovered >= 110 of 114, resolved >= 1,400. BEATS (coordinator's definition): MATCHES and the summed-excess paired 95% interval's lower bound > 0. Round 4's stricter 'beats' (summed >= token + 0.02 with interval > 0, no caller F1 more than 0.01 below token) is reported alongside. Also reported: the configuration against the base (paired, even and odd), tier-2 instance and island counts, CRISPR-Cas member genes touching support.
expectation_before_any_number: Odd: the gated tier lowers the base's odd shortfall (0.57, all of it CCT) and selects e = 4 or 6. Even: CCT F1 rises over the base by +0.015 to +0.030 (the 'missed' loci cost -0.053 and about half of the lost Cas boundaries are Poisson-markable); DefenseFinder and TXSScan F1 and summed excess move by less than 0.005 against the base; ribosomal resolved unchanged (1,404 +- 5). Verdict: MATCHES and BEATS (coordinator's definition) with probability about 0.6; the base already meets every other bar (TXSScan -0.017 against a -0.02 tolerance, resolved 1,404).
refuted_if: The reading 'the CCT deficit is support-free Cas loci left by the rank-weight floor, and Poisson evidence confined to tier-1-silent regions restores them without touching the rest' is refuted if, on even genomes, (a) CCT F1 rises by < 0.010 over the base, or (b) DefenseFinder F1, TXSScan F1 or summed excess changes by more than 0.01 against the base, or (c) ribosomal resolved changes by more than 5 runs. (a) alone would mean the islands are too few or read badly; (b)/(c) would mean the gate does not isolate tier 2.
not_done_here: No change to the exclusion rule, list construction, depth, weights or reading parameters; no lineage-free map (the default lineage array is used, as by the base).
